label: Betterness varies within an end-realization class
paraphrase: OPEN analyst premise, attribution deferred: for some variation scenario s and candidates x, y, at least one not a present input at s, x is a better good than y at s (STANDARD_OF_FAVOURING_1, the relation of a ValueStandardOrder), and at some scenario that agrees with s on end-realization x is not better than y. It is good-generality of the betterness standard itself (BECAUSE_OF_GOODNESS_2 applied to the standard as a profile) and holds exactly when some profile is good-general. Betterness factoring through end-realization (a member of the #2172 variationCore) implies its denial; the converse fails in general because of the present-input clause. It does not say which scenarios are metaphysically possible; on the control carrier the witness is cBetter against actual.
